body: I suspect it has more to do with a change of behavior in the Hibernate ORM extension so pinging @yrodiere .

Hey @jedla97, thank you for reporting the issue! This looks indeed very similar to https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/50247, but I believe you're hitting a slightly different case. That issue was already fixed by checking if there were [no entities mapped to the default PU](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/50262), which is your case as well.

But, because of the `import.sql` file being present in your class-path, the Hibernate ORM extension is enabling the implicit (i.e. `<default>`) persistence unit. See here:

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/5de5ea1bf232f358eb84e9c03188ab63940baad9/extensions/hibernate-orm/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/hibernate/orm/deployment/HibernateOrmProcessor.java#L893

And here:

https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/5de5ea1bf232f358eb84e9c03188ab63940baad9/extensions/hibernate-orm/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/hibernate/orm/deployment/HibernateOrmConfigPersistenceUnit.java#L250

This, in turn, is why you're seeing this error. A valid workaround for now would be to set `quarkus.hibernate-orm.enabled=false`, disabling the Hibernate ORM extension.

Why do you have an `import.sql` script in the first place, though? I'm guessing Hibernate is what's processing it anyway, being the underlying implementation for Spring Data JPA, so you might want to have the ORM extension enabled.

body:
Thanks @mbellade for some pointers.

> Why do you have an import.sql script in the first place, though?
I trim the reproducer whom bigger application. We test it with bunch of extensions together with some some base properties and files. The tests it's there for long time so I can't exact reason as I don't know.

> This, in turn, is why you're seeing this error. A valid workaround for now would be to set quarkus.hibernate-orm.enabled=false, disabling the Hibernate ORM extension.

I play with it and the workaround for me is also just setting the `quarkus.hibernate-orm.sql-load-script=` and it's not loaded in buildtime

After playing with it for some time I think that the https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/840ee212526ee244acbf1f5847ac2f3db5324692/extensions/spring-data-jpa/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/spring/data/deployment/SqlFileConfigBuilderCustomizer.java#L28-L33

I think this should be added only in dev/test mode. It will add it every time so even in prod mode, which differ from hibernate. So probably fix for this should be only add the `quarkus.hibernate-orm.sql-load-script` if the launch mode is dev/test or user add `quarkus.hibernate-orm.sql-load-script` manually. The `SqlFileConfigBuilderCustomizer` was added because the spring use `data.sql` instead of `import.sql` so user have easier migration.

So I don't think it's the error in hibernate but in spring-data-jpa.

issue.title: Only use `SqlFileConfigBuilderCustomizer` for spring-data-jpa in dev and test mode
